nodes.text:
Human metapneumovirus (HMPV): Symptoms, prevention and risks

Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus that causes upper and lower respiratory diseases in people.

This virus is especially risky for young children, older people and people with weakened immune systems. https://t.co/LdPiOXMzai
